description: Agglo - Transport public structurant - Stratégie PA is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Projet d'agglomération de 5ème génération (2025), données schématiques de stratégie. Le réseau de transports publics (TP) structurants est une part essentielle de la stratégie mobilité du projet d'agglomération. Il représente les composantes existantes et en projet du réseau principal (train, tram, bus à haut niveau de service) à horizon 2050. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
